description: Run a bounded, read-only structured query against your PAPI project. Allowed entities are tasks, learnings, builds, reviews, and owner_actions; use typed filters and a limit of at most 100. This never accepts SQL, table names, project selectors, joins, writes, or repository paths.

fields.description: Comma-separated allowlisted fields. Defaults to all safe fields for the entity.

filters.description: Typed equality filters. Project identity and query expressions are server-bound and cannot be supplied.

name: query
